answer_1.quote: Keyphrases encapsulate the core information of a document. Due to their high information density, they have been found valuable in areas such as information retrieval , document clustering , summarization , and text classification .

answer_2.quote: Evaluation We adopt lexical-based and semantic-based evaluation to evaluate a model's predictions P = {p 1 , p 2 , ..., p m } against Y. For lexical evaluation, we follow Chan et al. ( ) and use the P @M , R@M , and F 1@M scores. ... For semantic evaluation, we follow  and report SemP , SemR, and SemF 1.
